The short version: Cruva is an AI "operating system" for TikTok Shop brands, roughly $199 to $599 a month, that connects your affiliate workflow from finding creators to measuring revenue, and you operate it. Tokgency runs that program for you as a managed agency and is accountable for GMV. Same destination, different driver.

An "operating system" still needs an operator running a disciplined loop. One seller described that loop as "1 to 3 hero products, a strong TikTok-exclusive offer, competitive creator commissions, consistent sample outreach, clear hooks, not rigid scripts" (@jordantwestecom on X). Cruva gives you the cockpit; the flying is still yours.

What Cruva is

Cruva positions itself as an AI operating system for TikTok Shop affiliate programs. It offers:

  • Creator segmentation and automated messaging
  • AI sample approval on Growth and higher tiers
  • Content tracking and a creator community
  • Revenue measurement across the workflow

Pricing runs about $199 to $599/mo, with enterprise above that. It is a modern, capable tool for a team that has the capacity to run it.

What Tokgency is

Tokgency is a TikTok-only managed agency plus a creator-discovery tool. We do the recruiting, seeding, negotiation, briefs, management, ads, and reporting, and we own the GMV outcome rather than shipping you features.

Side by side

Cruva Tokgency
Model AI software (OS) Managed agency (+ tool)
Who operates it You Us
Pricing ~$199 to $599/mo Flexible, commission-friendly
Accountable for Workflow and data GMV driven
Best when You have creator-ops capacity You want the outcome

An "operating system" still needs an operator. Cruva gives you the cockpit; you fly the plane. If you have a pilot, great. If not, the cockpit sits empty.

When Cruva is the better pick

  • You have a team that will genuinely run the tool daily.
  • You want in-house control and a modern workflow.
  • You value the creator community and segmentation features.

When Tokgency is the better pick

  • You want the program executed for you.
  • You would rather buy an outcome than operate software.
  • You want fees that can align to GMV.

If you are weighing tooling against a managed team more broadly, read DIY, software, or agency and our best affiliate software comparison.

Want a straight recommendation for your shop? Book a call, or try the creator finder to see who sells in your category first.
